text: *ST九鼎公告，公司因对2023-2024年存货及投资性房地产核算不准确，涉嫌信息披露违法违规，中国证监会决定对公司立案；公司各项经营活动均正常开展，将积极配合调查工作。
text_en: *ST Jiuding announced that, due to inaccurate accounting of inventory and investment properties for 2023-2024, the company is suspected of information disclosure violations, and the CSRC has decided to open an investigation into the company; all of the company's business activities are operating normally, and it will actively cooperate with the investigation.
